units.title: Pipeline Run — D2 Blanking Die (vs ITW SHAKEPROOF)
units.description: Programmatic WireEDMContour (hex + bore) run through WEDMPrintToProgramEngine; asserts 4-pass plan, offset band 0.05-0.5mm, feed band 0.5-20 mm/min, setup-sheet part number.

units.title: Pipeline Run — Taper Part (vs NOZE TEST)
units.description: SS304 rectangle with taper_angle_deg=5 run through pipeline; asserts 5-pass plan, G51 / UV markers present, predicted_ra ≤ 0.8 µm cascade.

units.title: 5-Part Pipeline Benchmark
units.description: 4 materials (D2/SS304/Al/Ti) × 3 controllers (mitsubishi/fanuc/sodick) = 12 happy-path tests + 1 cross-scenario stability check + 1 safety-gate test (carbide with brass-wire defaults must throw SafetyBlockError).

units.title: Pipeline Error Handling
units.description: 7 failure-mode tests: empty contours, open (non-closed) contour, zero thickness, NaN thickness, negative target_ra, negative wire diameter, no geometry at all.
